QuestInfo.name: Gold Richie's Bribe
QuestInfo.0: Gold Richie wants you to come see him, because he has something to ask you.
QuestInfo.1: Gold Richie has decided to bribe some of the Black Wing members, so they won't suspect his support of the Resistance. He thinks that Bavan might enjoy receiving some stuffed monsters. Gold Richie asks that you catch #bZeno#k for stuffing and bring back #bZeno's Gloves#k.
QuestInfo.2: You caught Zeno and delivered Zeno's Gloves.

0.0: You've come. Today's job will be pretty difficult... Do you think you can handle it?

yes.0: Today's job is to catch #bZeno#k, and then bring back #bZeno's Gloves#k.
yes.1: What am I going to use it for? Oh, it's more of a decoy mission... I think the Black Wings are beginning to notice my support for the Resistance. This should throw them off the track.
yes.2: The moment the Black Wings find out about my support of the Resistance, my treasures, and even my life, are at risk! They must not find out!
yes.3: Maybe if we bribed Anthony the Black Wing Captain, they would go easy on their surveillance. After thinking it through, I've decided to give a stuffed Zeno as a gift. But it's not easy to find, so I'll need your help.

no.0: Hmm... Is it too difficult? Oh well... Think about it, and come back if you think you want to try.

1.0: Did you catch it? What about #bZeno's Gloves#k?

yes.0: Hmm... It's in decent condition... Impressive. This will help us escape Black Wings' surveillance for a bit.

item.0: Bring me Zeno's Gloves. They're absolutely essential if we want to escape Black Wings' surveillance.
